help: the standing forge report, the acts, the report again: refuse-class drift refuses before anything irreversible, the squash lands pinned to the inspected head, this checkout converges on the PR's base, the merge commit is read back, and the last word is the checkout's own state (git status --short --branch); the forge's roster stays one command away — no message flags, so the body is assembled from the branch's commits and keeps their signatures

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to merge: a number, a URL, or a branch

sends: gh pr view — reads the PR's head and base before the irreversible step, and reads the merge commit back after it
gh pr merge --squash — WRITES the merge (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git fetch origin — reads the squash back so the base can fast-forward
